pages.title: Transcendent Metal Ingot
pages.text: In the forge, above stellar-core temperatures, properties like hardness and conductivity stop being fixed and start being chosen. This ingot is what a metal looks like when someone else chose them. It weighs exactly what the forge decided, and feels faintly as though it might change its mind.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I fed the forge a hypernova alloy and things that are barely matter at all: an aleph-null shard, Russell's paradox, a cosmic processor. The processor set the rules, the paradox loosened the old ones, and the metal accepted whatever properties it was given.

Made in $(item)Transcendent Plasma Forge$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Stellar Transcendence.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Apeiron Ingot, Axiomatic Field Emitter, Omniscience Catalyst, Omnium Ingot, Pleroma Confluence.
